Fit SPM for a custom target variable

Source: R/spm_opta.R
fit_spm_opta_target.Rd

Convenience wrapper around fit_spm_opta that allows fitting SPM on any target column (not just the default rapm). Useful for multi-target RAPM where each value metric (EPV, WPA, PSV) has its own RAPM rating that needs an SPM predictor.

Usage

fit_spm_opta_target(data, target_col = "rapm", ...)

Arguments

data

Player features data with RAPM ratings. Must contain a column named target_col.

target_col

Name of the target column (e.g., "rapm_epv", "rapm_wpa", "rapm_psv"). This column is temporarily renamed to "rapm" for compatibility with fit_spm_model().

...

Additional arguments passed to fit_spm_opta.

Value

Fitted SPM model (same as fit_spm_opta).
